Find vetted professionals, follow each step in real time, and pay only when the job is completed and approved by you.

Manage your assets with documentation, insurance and warranties, maintenance history, costs, inventory, photos, and more.

Scale operations with trusted providers nationwide—standards, control, and full visibility from request to completion.

NO_VISION_INTEGRATION.title: Biometrics unavailable
NO_VISION_INTEGRATION.message: Facial recognition is not set up for your organization yet. Contact your administrator or support.

NO_VERIFICATION_KEY.title: Incomplete setup
NO_VERIFICATION_KEY.message: Face verification is not fully configured on the server. Ask an admin to review vision integrations in the panel.

UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE.title: Biometrics unavailable
UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE.message: This type of face verification is not available right now. Contact support.

FACE_MISMATCH.title: Photo not accepted
FACE_MISMATCH.message: We could not confirm you match the step 1 profile photo. Take another photo: face forward, good light, no sunglasses or items covering your face.

FACE_ALREADY_REGISTERED.title: Face already registered
FACE_ALREADY_REGISTERED.message: This face is already linked to another account in your organization. Use the account that already has your biometrics or contact your company.

VERIFY_OR_INVALID_IMAGE.title: Invalid image
VERIFY_OR_INVALID_IMAGE.message: We could not use this photo for comparison. Try another sharper image with only your face.

NO_FACE_DETECTED.title: No face detected
NO_FACE_DETECTED.message: We could not find a clear face in this photo. Face the camera with good light; avoid hats, masks, or dark glasses.

MULTIPLE_FACES.title: Too many people in the photo
MULTIPLE_FACES.message: The photo must show only you. Take another picture without other people in the frame.

FACE_TOO_SMALL.title: Framing
FACE_TOO_SMALL.message: Move a bit closer: your face should appear larger and sharp in the photo.

LOW_QUALITY_FACE.title: Photo quality
LOW_QUALITY_FACE.message: The image is blurry or shaky. Use more light and hold the phone steady.

BIOMETRY_TIMEOUT.title: Timed out
BIOMETRY_TIMEOUT.message: Verification took too long. Try again with a better network or a slightly smaller image.

TECH_IDENTITY_LOCKED.title: Registration locked
TECH_IDENTITY_LOCKED.message: Your provider account is already active. Profile photo and recognition photos can only be changed by your company in the admin panel.

SERVICE_BUSY.title: Service busy
SERVICE_BUSY.message: Face verification is slow or temporarily unavailable. Wait a moment and send the photo again.

PROFILE_REQUIRED.title: Complete step 1
PROFILE_REQUIRED.message: Complete and validate your profile photo first.

PHOTO_REJECTED_GENERIC.title: Photo not accepted
PHOTO_REJECTED_GENERIC.message: We could not use this photo for verification. Take another with your face forward, well lit, and alone in the frame.

UPLOAD_NETWORK.title: Could not send
UPLOAD_NETWORK.message: Something went wrong while sending the photo. Check your connection and try again.

TECH_IDENTITY_LOCKED.title: Registration locked
TECH_IDENTITY_LOCKED.message: Your provider account is already active. ID document and biometric data can only be changed by your company in the admin panel.

ID_DOC_IMAGE_REQUIRED.title: Send a photo
ID_DOC_IMAGE_REQUIRED.message: This step needs an image of the document (JPEG or PNG). PDF cannot compare the face on the document with your profile photo.

FACE_STEP_REQUIRED.title: Step 2 pending
FACE_STEP_REQUIRED.message: Complete the biometric photos from step 2 first.

ID_DOC_FLOW_MISMATCH.title: Flow not available
ID_DOC_FLOW_MISMATCH.message: This step does not apply to your registration type.

NO_OPENAI_DEFAULT.title: Service unavailable
NO_OPENAI_DEFAULT.message: The server is not configured for this step (OpenAI). Contact support or your administrator.

FACE_VERIFY_FAILED.title: Document comparison
FACE_VERIFY_FAILED.message: We could not compare the document photo with your profile photo now. Check your connection and try again shortly.

OCR_OR_SERVER.title: Reading the document
OCR_OR_SERVER.message: We could not extract the data. Try a sharper photo without glare, with the full document visible.

DOC_COMPARE_5XX.title: Document comparison
DOC_COMPARE_5XX.message: The server could not compare the document photo with your profile right now. Check your connection and try again shortly.

FACE_MISMATCH.title: Check the document photo
FACE_MISMATCH.message: We could not confirm the small photo on the ID matches your profile photo. Take another photo: document open on the photo page, well lit, without strong plastic glare, and ensure your step 1 profile photo is current.

VERIFY_NO_SCORE.title: Document photo
VERIFY_NO_SCORE.message: The comparison between the document image and your profile photo was unclear. Try another document photo with the ID portrait clearly visible.

NO_FACE_DETECTED.title: Photo on document
NO_FACE_DETECTED.message: The face photo on the document is not sharp enough. Frame the document front-on, zoom slightly on the portrait area, use diffuse light and avoid plastic glare.

MULTIPLE_FACES.title: Document image
MULTIPLE_FACES.message: More than one face is visible. Frame only the document or the page with your portrait.

FACE_TOO_SMALL.title: Document framing
FACE_TOO_SMALL.message: The portrait on the document is too small. Move closer while keeping the whole document readable.

LOW_QUALITY_FACE.title: Image quality
LOW_QUALITY_FACE.message: The document photo is blurry or shaky. Use more light and hold the phone steady.

INVALID_IMAGE.title: Invalid image
INVALID_IMAGE.message: The image is invalid or too small. Send another sharp document photo (JPEG or PNG).
